metadataRaw.title: How to Self Release Your Neck and Shoulders
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to self release stiffness in your neck and shoulders AT HOME, using no special equipment! 

This video will be broken into an EASY step-by-step guide that will show exercises to self mobilize, release, or pop the neck (cervical spine) and shoulder. 

They'll focus on improving mobility throughout the neck, upper back and shoulders, which may lead to LESS PAIN, tightness, and better range of motion. 

As a bonus, these neck and shoulder stretching exercises can be done at home (or work), pretty much ANYPLACE and ANYTIME! That way you'll be able to relieve pain and tightness in the neck and shoulders QUICKLY, and get the pop or release you're looking for.

WATCH now and safely pop your neck and shoulder at home for quick relief!
